routers.title: Routers
routers.description: Block page addresses of the nixos-router portals this browser should use, e.g. blocked.gw.example.com:8068. HTTPS only; the port defaults to 8068. Users see these as set by their administrator and cannot remove them, but must still grant the extension access to each one.

items.description: One router portal address: blocked.<router domain name>, optionally followed by :<port>.
